terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of MaquiControl, the platform by AndesHeavyTech that connects heavy machinery fleet owners with contractors who need to rent it. By creating an account you accept them.

service.title: 1. The service
service.body: MaquiControl lets fleet owners publish machinery, manage reservations, maintenance and service operations, and lets contractors request rentals. MaquiControl is an intermediary: the rental agreement is between the owner and the contractor.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts and roles
accounts.body: You must give truthful information and keep your password private. Each account has a role (fleet owner or contractor) that defines what it can do. You are responsible for the activity carried out with your account.

owners.title: 3. Fleet owner responsibilities
owners.body: Owners must publish real machinery with accurate rates, keep it in safe working condition, register maintenance and breakdowns honestly, and respect the reservations they confirm.

contractors.title: 4. Contractor responsibilities
contractors.body: Contractors must use the machinery only for the agreed work and period, with qualified operators, report breakdowns as soon as they happen and return the machinery in the condition it was delivered.

payments.title: 5. Rates and payments
payments.body: Estimated totals are calculated from the hourly rate and an 8-hour workday for each day of the period, both dates included. The final amount is based on the worked hours validated by both parties.

privacy.title: 6. Personal data
privacy.body: We only collect the data needed to provide the service and treat it according to Peruvian Law No. 29733 on Personal Data Protection. We do not sell your data. You can ask to access, correct or delete it at any time.

ethics.title: 7. Professional and ethical commitment
ethics.body: MaquiControl is developed following the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP): we act in the public interest, are transparent about how the product works and its limitations, and put the safety of people who operate the machinery first.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of liability
liability.body: MaquiControl does not own the machinery and is not liable for damage caused by misuse, lack of maintenance or breach of the agreement between owner and contractor. We work to keep the platform available but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service.

changes.title: 9. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. We will announce relevant changes inside the application before they take effect.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact the AndesHeavyTech team through the MaquiControl landing page.
